functions.name: WendyDeviceGetInfo
functions.ownership: inputs are borrowed; the operation and callback result are owned
functions.threading: safe for concurrent calls; completion runs on a Wendy worker thread
functions.comment: Requests current information from a connected device. The request bytes encode `wendy.sdk.v1.GetDeviceInfoRequest`. Successful completion bytes encode `wendy.sdk.v1.DeviceInfo`. Binding pattern: async-unary. Ownership: inputs are borrowed; the operation and callback result are owned. Threading: safe for concurrent calls; completion runs on a Wendy worker thread. Cancellation: completes exactly once with `WendyErrorCancelled`. Availability: 0.1.0-draft.

functions.name: WendyDeviceRetain

functions.name: WendyDeviceWatchState
functions.signature: WendyStream *(const WendyDevice *, WendyDataView, const WendyStreamCallbacks *, void *)
functions.ownership: inputs are borrowed; the stream and callback items are owned
functions.threading: item callbacks are serialized on a Wendy worker thread
functions.comment: Watches complete state snapshots for a connected device. Request bytes encode `wendy.sdk.v1.WatchDeviceStateRequest`; every item encodes `wendy.sdk.v1.DeviceState`. Item callbacks are serialized and consume one unit of demand. `onComplete` runs exactly once; its error is NULL after normal completion. Binding pattern: demand-driven-stream. Ownership: inputs are borrowed; the stream and callback items are owned. Threading: item callbacks are serialized on a Wendy worker thread. Cancellation: completes exactly once with `WendyErrorCancelled`. Availability: 0.1.0-draft.

messages.name: wendy.sdk.v1.DeviceInfo
messages.comment: DeviceInfo is an immutable snapshot returned by Device.GetInfo.

fields.name: id
fields.comment: Stable SDK identity for the device.

fields.name: name
fields.comment: Human-readable device name, when one is available.

messages.name: wendy.sdk.v1.DeviceState
messages.comment: DeviceState is a complete state snapshot, not a delta to fold locally.

messages.name: wendy.sdk.v1.GetDeviceInfoRequest
messages.comment: GetDeviceInfoRequest requests the current information for the receiving device. The receiver carries device identity, so the request is empty.

messages.name: wendy.sdk.v1.WatchDeviceStateRequest
messages.comment: WatchDeviceStateRequest starts observing the receiving device.

enums.name: wendy.sdk.v1.DeviceState.Availability
enums.comment: Availability describes whether the SDK currently considers the device reachable.

values.name: AVAILABILITY_UNSPECIFIED
values.comment: The availability is not yet known.

values.name: AVAILABILITY_OFFLINE
values.comment: The device is known but currently unreachable.

services.name: wendy.sdk.v1.Device
services.comment: Device describes the smallest representative SDK object surface. These operations exist to exercise unary and streaming binding patterns; they are not yet a complete Wendy device API.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.comment: Returns the current identity and display information for a connected device. C bridge: WendyDeviceGetInfo. Binding pattern: async-unary.

methods.name: WatchState
methods.comment: Watches state snapshots until the caller cancels or the device closes. C bridge: WendyDeviceWatchState. Binding pattern: demand-driven-stream.
